speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
title: God Is at Your Side
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus spoke about “God Is at Your Side”.

quotes.text: Today I invite you to look at your life and what you want to achieve with enthusiasm and the certainty that your Father in Heaven will guide you on that journey and show you the best way to make the righteous desires of your heart come true.
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I want to illustrate this concept with an experience. On my way to the dentist, I put the address in my phone. While I was driving on the freeway, the GPS thought I was on a parallel street and kept telling me to turn right—when there was no place to turn. Finally, I pulled off the freeway and called my husband for help. When I gave him my exact location, he was able to guide me to the place I wanted to go.
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Dear young women, the Lord knows where you are; He has your exact location and can guide you. He knows your dreams and your gifts. He knows when you feel alone and what your questions are. He knows your challenges and how to turn your weaknesses into strengths. He knows everything. And knowing everything about you does not make Him love you less.
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Once a young man came running, kneeling before Jesus Christ, and asking Him, “What can I do to gain eternal life?” The young man said he had always obeyed the commandments. Would Jesus know what else this young man could do? Of course! But before He tells him, look at what happened. In Mark 10:21, we read, “Jesus beholding him loved him.”
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Can you imagine those moments when Jesus looks at this young man? A look that conveys only love: love of the highest quality. Only after transmitting that love did He tell him what he could do to improve.
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Our Father and our Savior know you and have the same perfect love for you. Part of that love and mercy is giving us many opportunities and being patient as we learn and work on our list of aspirations.
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Dear young women, I testify that you are beloved daughters of heavenly parents, with a divine nature and an eternal destiny. Each of you has a crucial and important work to do here on earth. That work is different for each person, but if you choose to love God and Jesus Christ and to trust Them, doing that work will bring you the same great joy.
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I would like to share seven ways that will help you in this endeavor. I invite you to listen to the Spirit to choose one to focus on over the next few weeks.
quotes.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

scriptures.text: We believe in being honest, true, chaste, benevolent, virtuous, and in doing good to all men; indeed, we may say that we follow the admonition of Paul--We believe all things, we hope all things, we have endured many things, and hope to be able to endure all things. If there is anything virtuous, lovely, or of good report or praiseworthy, we seek after these things.

Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
